json_ld.description:
This lightweight body moisturizer with 0.05% retinol helps firm skin’s appearance and improves the look of uneven tone and texture. Squalane and ceramide NP work together to deliver hydration and lock it in, keeping skin moisturized and comfortable. The fragrance-free cream absorbs instantly and leaves skin feeling silky and soft, never sticky or greasy. This formula has been clinically tested for sensitive skin.
